backend_changes.summary: POST /auth/login returns a complete auth state with user identity, session_token, auth_complete=true, require_password_change, and message.
LoginResponse and AuthenticatedUser schemas include session_token, auth_complete, and organization_id.
Login hot path is limited to user lookup, password verification, lightweight session creation, and commit. Login side effects are queued.
Added get_session_id_from_request to resolve X-Session-Token or Bearer token before cookie fallback.
Authenticated API dependencies now use the unified session resolver.
/auth/me short-circuit and control-plane isolation now use the unified session resolver.
Org context middleware now authenticates with the unified session resolver without changing RBAC logic.
Permission isolation middleware now receives the same resolved session id without changing permission decisions.
Data isolation middleware now uses the same resolved session id.
Heavy-request guard session identity now uses token-aware session resolution.

frontend_changes.summary: loginRequest disables retry, enforces auth_complete=true and session_token, and normalizes organization_id.
Login success is based on session_token/auth_complete. Auth state is persisted as a token snapshot. /auth/me is background hydration and cannot block an already authenticated session.
Login submission is single-flight and separates 401 invalid credentials from timeout/backend failures.
API requests attach X-Session-Token from the authenticated snapshot and suppress global unauthorized handling for /auth/login and /auth/me.
Next proxy forwards X-Session-Token to the backend and keys capability bootstrap cache by both cookie and token.

behavior_after_fix.login_success_rule: backend auth_complete=true plus session_token means frontend authenticated
behavior_after_fix.redirect_rule: login success redirects immediately without waiting for /auth/me
behavior_after_fix.permission_loading_rule: permission and org context remain lazy and outside the login success decision
behavior_after_fix.error_rule: 401 from /auth/login is invalid credentials; timeout/backend failures are service errors

success_criteria_mapping.login_success_stable: single login attempt, no overlapping requests, token becomes request auth header
success_criteria_mapping.no_false_401_on_valid_login: backend accepts X-Session-Token across auth dependencies and middlewares
success_criteria_mapping.auth_state_consistent_after_refresh: stored auth snapshot restores authenticated state and background /auth/me cannot clear it on supplemental failure
success_criteria_mapping.backend_no_longer_blocks_login_path: login side effects are async and auth context/permission loading is not in the login response path
